remaining_validation_gaps: The fresh repo does not yet contain the upstream workflow inventory as committed migration evidence.
The fresh repo does not yet contain the new .NET 10 + Avalonia solution skeleton.
No real DNPPV-2.0 product code has been ported into this repository yet.
The full cross-platform publish pipeline for the migrated product has not been created yet.
current_operational_recommendations: Execute CR-001 first and treat it as the acceptance contract for all downstream product-port work.
Do not reintroduce WPF, Windows-only target frameworks, or Windows-installer assets into the active 2.0 lane.
Do not claim visual product progress from any scaffold or toy application surface.
Close each CR with reviewed commits, pushed evidence, and a tracker update before opening the next implementation increment.
